categories.main_business_segments: Ganfeng Lithium operates a vertically integrated lithium ecosystem covering upstream lithium resource development, midstream lithium compounds and lithium metals processing, downstream lithium battery production, and lithium battery recycling. The company’s three reportable segments are lithium metal and compound manufacturing and sales, lithium battery manufacturing and sales including energy storage services, and lithium ore resource exploration and sales including phosphate ore and other lithium products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes industrialized technologies for lithium extraction from brine, ore, and decommissioned batteries. It has developed advanced production lines for lithium hydroxide, lithium carbonate, lithium metals (including ultra-thin lithium strips and lithium alloys), and solid-state lithium batteries with proprietary sulfide and oxide electrolyte materials. Ganfeng also employs intelligent manufacturing, digitalization, and process optimization to enhance efficiency and product quality, and leads in battery recycling technologies with environmentally friendly processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ganfeng’s customers include global leaders in electric vehicles, battery cathode material manufacturers, battery suppliers, pharmaceutical companies, and consumer electronics brands. Its lithium products serve electric vehicles, aerospace, functional materials, pharmaceuticals, portable electronics, and energy storage markets. The company also collaborates with manufacturers of heavy trucks, forklifts, drones, and UAVs, reflecting diversified end-use applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with lithium resource projects in Australia, Argentina, Mali (Africa), Ireland, China (Jiangxi, Qinghai, Inner Mongolia), Mexico, and the Republic of Congo. Its production bases are mainly in China (Jiangxi, Guangdong, Sichuan, Qinghai, Chongqing, Jiangsu) and Argentina. Sales are primarily in Mainland China (77.4% of revenue) and overseas markets (22.6%), including South Korea, Europe, North America, and other Asian countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ganfeng operates across the entire lithium supply chain, from upstream resource extraction (lithium ore mining and salt lake brine extraction), midstream processing of lithium compounds and metals, downstream lithium battery manufacturing, to end-of-life lithium battery recycling. This vertical integration enables synergies and stable supply assurance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in solid-state battery technology, including sulfide and oxide electrolytes, lithium metal anodes, and high-energy-density battery cells. It focuses on lean production, energy-saving, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing. Ganfeng actively develops new lithium extraction methods, battery recycling technologies, and integrated energy storage solutions. It also invests in talent development and innovation platforms to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Ganfeng generates revenue primarily through the sale of lithium compounds, lithium metals, lithium batteries, and related products. It also earns income from processing services, energy storage services, and lithium battery recycling. The company engages in strategic off-take agreements and provides integrated solutions to customers, enhancing value through the full lithium industry chain.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ganfeng is positioned as a world-leading lithium ecological enterprise with the most comprehensive lithium product offerings globally. It is the largest lithium metal producer worldwide and the largest lithium compound supplier in China. The company holds significant upstream resource interests and maintains a strong market position through vertical integration and technological innovation. It competes with other major lithium producers and battery manufacturers globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Ganfeng reported revenue of RMB 18.7 billion, a 42.9% decrease from 2023, and a gross profit of RMB 2.1 billion, down 53.2%. The company recorded a net loss attributable to owners of RMB 2.07 billion in 2024, compared to a profit of RMB 4.98 billion in 2023. Total assets grew 10% to RMB 100.8 billion, while net assets decreased 9% to RMB 47.6 billion. The company has significant capital expenditures and a gearing ratio of 53%. It employs over 16,000 staff and maintains a broad global resource and production footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ganfeng’s unique value proposition lies in its vertically integrated lithium ecosystem, enabling stable supply, cost optimization, and technological synergies across the lithium value chain. Its comprehensive product portfolio of over 40 lithium compounds and metals, advanced solid-state battery technology, and leading battery recycling capabilities differentiate it in the market. The company emphasizes high safety, long life, high energy density, and sustainability in its products and solutions, fostering strategic partnerships with global industry leaders.
